answer_4.quote: We recruit two human experts who are well-versed in the field of event extraction. We conduct three rounds of annotations and discussions to improve consistency and ensure a high inter-annotator agreement (IAA).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are provided with a list of frame elements along with their descriptions for each frame in the event ontology. They are also provided with definitions for events and argument roles as discussed in Section 3.1. Based on these definitions, they are asked to annotate each frame element as (a) not argument role, (b) argument role, or (c) merge with existing argument role (and mention the argument role to merge with).
